_comment: Refreshable logo manifest for decks. Resolves each brand's official logo from Wikidata (property P154 'logo image') via a search term, then downloads from Wikimedia Commons. 'commons' overrides with an explicit Commons filename; 'url' with a direct download; 'local' copies an existing file (path relative to this dir). Re-run refresh_logos.py to pull the latest. Naming: <type>-<category>-<Name>.<ext>, where type is 'logo' (default) or 'icon' (product connector UI icons). Categories: data (warehouses/DBs/storage/connectors + syndicated data providers), bi (BI/semantic/catalog tools), cloud (cloud platforms), comms (messaging/destinations), firm (customers), output, ai (first-party Tellius corporate marks) and Tellius (first-party product marks e.g. Kaiya); first-party marks use 'self: true', committed directly with no external refresh source.
